 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the Insurer challenging the Award dated 03.03.2023, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/Additional District Judge, Ramnagar, District Nainital in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 118 of 2021, "Smt. Poonam Devi and Others vs. Sona Thakur and Others", by which, learned Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs. 1,08,15,445/- (Rupees one crore eight lakh fifteen thousand four hundred forty five), as compensation along with an interest at the rate of 7 percent per annum from the date of Petition till its actual payment.
2.

sentences.text: Heard Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for the appellant.
3. Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate, submitted that the appellant, Insurance Company, does not want to press paragraph no. 5 (page no. 3) of Memo of Appeal.
4. This Appeal is admitted on the ground taken by Insurance Company in paragraph nos. 3 and 4 of the Memo of Appeal.

5. Issue notice to respondent no. 1, respondent no. 5 and respondent no. 6.
6. Steps to be taken within a week.
7. List on 05.09.2023.
8.
Heard on Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2023).
9. Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate has sought eight weeks' period to deposit 50 percent amount of the awarded amount.

11. Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.
12. The said amount will be kept in the form of FDR in any nationalized bank.
